title: Law of logarithms
text: We are actually showing that we get the law of logarithms for products from the law of logarithms for exponents. That is what we are proving. We cannot use the law of logarithms to prove it since that would be circular.

title: Substitute the given information into the last step
text: This step substitutes the given, $$\log_b(m)=a$$ and $$\log_b(n) $$=$$ $$c, $$ in for $$a$$ and $$c$$ in step $$7$$.
